title: Google Play reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one user review, charged), app (context for an app in a language and country, free) and status (per app, language and country, free).

dataset.title: Google Play reviews
dataset.description: One row per review, plus per-app rows and per-job status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; app and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered/duplicate/error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
